resources.string: Hold a page to move it. Uncheck a page to hide it: its apps stay in the App Library.
Home keeps at least one page.

plurals.name: edit_pages_remove_apps
plurals.item: Its app comes off Home and stays in the App Library.
Its %1$d apps come off Home and stay in the App Library.

plurals.name: edit_pages_remove_folders
plurals.item: Its folder moves to another page, with its apps.
Its %1$d folders move to another page, with their apps.

resources.string: Until Home changes again, Undo last layout change in Settings brings it all back.
Home changed while pages were being edited, so nothing was changed. Try again.
A widget kept from an older version of Duos can\'t change pages, so the pages stayed in order.
Home can\'t be edited right now, so the pages stayed as they were.
Only empty or hidden pages can be removed.
